sources.entry: claude-howto by luongnv89 - A structured, chapter-based getting-started guide for Claude Code with a self-assessment quiz and a ten-module progressive learning path — slash commands, memory, skills, subagents, MCP, hooks, plugins, and checkpoints — with visual diagrams and copy-paste templates.

summary.one_liner: A chapter-based tutorial guide for learning Claude Code, with ten progressive modules covering slash commands, memory, skills, subagents, MCP, hooks, plugins, checkpoints, and CLI usage, plus copy-paste templates.
summary.what_it_does: The repository is a Markdown-based guide organized into ten numbered folders (01-slash-commands through 10-cli), each with a README and example files. It provides ready-to-copy artifacts such as slash command .md files, CLAUDE.md memory templates, a skill folder (code-review-specialist), subagent definitions (code-reviewer, secure-reviewer, and others), MCP JSON configs for GitHub, database, and filesystem servers, shell hook scripts, and a plugin (pr-review). It includes Mermaid diagrams explaining how features work and a suggested learning path with time estimates, from about 11 to 13 hours total. The README also describes a self-assessment and a /lesson-quiz command for checking understanding. It includes a script (scripts/build_epub.py) that builds an EPUB version of the guide with rendered diagrams, and the project has a pytest, Ruff, Bandit, and mypy test setup.
use_cases: Learning Claude Code step by step from beginner to advanced
Copying slash command templates into a project
Setting up CLAUDE.md project memory for a team
Configuring hooks to auto-format or scan code after edits
Connecting Claude Code to GitHub or databases via MCP
Building a reusable code review subagent or plugin
Reading the guide offline as an EPUB
how_to_run: git clone https://github.com/luongnv89/claude-howto (the README's clone command is missing the URL; this is the repo's standard address)
uv run scripts/build_epub.py (optional, to build an offline EPUB)
notable: Ten-module learning path with time estimates and a beginner/intermediate/advanced entry table
Mermaid diagrams explaining how each feature works internally
Ready-to-copy templates for commands, memory, skills, subagents, MCP, hooks, and plugins
Offline EPUB generation with rendered diagrams
caveats: Targets Claude Code 2.1+ and the README says it is synced to v2.1.310; the model list and version numbers may go out of date
Some installation details depend on the Claude Code release, and the README notes corporate proxies must allowlist a download host (the host name is cut off in the text)

The /lesson-quiz and /self-assessment features are described in the README but their implementation is not detailed here; the README also has some malformed or truncated parts (empty clone URL, empty Sources list)
keywords: learn claude code in a weekend
